description: This is a Java Spring Boot REST controller class that manages billable hours. It provides endpoints to list recent billable hours and to log new billable hour entries. The class uses annotations for API documentation, request mappings, and dependency injection.

classes.name: BillableHoursController
classes.description: REST controller providing API endpoints for listing and logging billable hours.

methods.name: recent
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of recent billable hours, with an optional limit parameter.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Handles POST requests to log a new billable hour entry based on the provided request body.
